rule: Long script opens with a viewer-attributed question, then reframes it in beat 2
limitation: one channel, no contrast set, no performance data

rule: No CTA wording in the script text; a red book-promo end card of about 10 s closes every long video
source_videos_or_locators: V019 (book promo), V020 (action); end card all 44 long, 0 of 24 Shorts
limitation: established channel with an existing audience: not evidence for a new channel

rule: Long script length reference: newer era median 632 words; older era 825
limitation: era difference not explained; no retention data

rule: Speech rate about 3.6 words per second
coverage: median 3.59 long, stable across eras (3.57 vs 3.63)

rule: Shorts are re-cuts of long scripts (8-gram containment >= 0.30)
limitation: contiguity not measured; V065 and V080 independent

rule: Narration starts at 0 s; the first visual event lands within about 2 s
coverage: first ASR <= 0.5 s in 88 of 88; first event median 1.8 to 2.0 s

rule: A visual event about every 2.1 s and 20 to 23 events per minute
Shot (hard-cut span) median 8.4 s long in the campaign ledgers, 6.7 s with the audit detector; state the detector and sample whenever quoting
limitation: Brain 7.77 s uses a different unit and sample

rule: About 93 to 94% of frames are visual holds
limitation: threshold-dependent; two continuous-motion videos at 31% and 55%

rule: Achromatic palette (dark line on near-white, or white on near-black) with one sparing red accent
Thin stroke about 6 px at a 1080 px short side (long 6.3, Short 5.7)
Large negative space: median 0.66 (long) and 0.77 (Short)
Stick figure: empty ring head, single-line body; figure height about 3.5 x head diameter
limitation: ring-detection heuristic, checked by eye on 24 frames; poses and expressions not coded

rule: The spoken number is on screen in about half of quantity moments
A numeral or unit label beside the drawing is the commonest quantity device; comparisons ride on layout (side-by-side, axis, bracket)
Visual events are mostly scene swaps, label or object pop-ons and write-ons, not camera moves
coverage: scene swap 19.7% long; no camera motion recorded in 615 of 718 shots
limitation: prior labels; pans and zooms over maps observed in U4cONnQxgvo stills (INFERRED)

rule: Machine association between speech clause starts and visual events is above chance (+about 20 points)
limitation: ASR provisional; direction unknown; not listening

rule: Mix loudness about -16.5 LUFS, compressed, almost no dead air
limitation: no listening: says nothing about voice or music quality

rule: Recompute every spoken physical number before reuse: of 10 checked claims 4 consistent, 4 with a caveat, 1 discrepant (lightning "two days"), 1 not verified
No 3D, parallax or perspective drawing was observed in the viewed stills; none is claimed
Pick the animation method from the scientific idea and the story function, cheapest sufficient method first
Measured shot boundaries need review: 77% were true cuts in 108 viewed shots; camera moves over maps and added content cause false boundaries
Do not copy xkcd artwork, scripts, jokes or audio; every production script passes the AI-slop gate; a PASS is a proxy
